title: Surreal Clock Tower Sphere
description: A tall ornate clock tower stands inside a large transparent sphere that rests on green rolling hills. The tower has multiple clock faces and is surrounded by colorful spheres, butterflies, and birds while the base shows a large circular design with painted marks.
prompt: A tall ornate clock tower with multiple clock faces stands at the center of a large transparent sphere resting on green rolling hills. Colorful spheres float around the tower along with butterflies and birds. The base of the tower features a large circular design with painted marks. The entire scene is contained within the sphere against a pale sky.
